title: The first screen always goes
notes: A touch at a sky's start always drops the first slab: touches reach the game by a second, direct route, and the first drop can't be held by a demo, a freeze or a sting.
The wind's sound, the passers-by and the wheel run fenced: one that fails on a phone is switched off and the climb goes on.
If a sky's start ever holds again: Options → Tester tools → screenshot the trace. It now records every touch and what it landed on.
